target: VII cumulative 41-item repair and one public release
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co across vacation, spa, events, hourly, holidays and shared place/search families

requirements.statement: Images load without unexplained blanks
Near-me labels and icons do not overlap
Rating score and count use one truth
Gallery actions are not duplicated
Amenities show 4 mobile and 12 desktop before expansion
vacation-1296 review facts agree
Popular searches hide for transactional searches
Recommendations load owner-matched images
Mobile maps render without white overlays
Review date picker and submission work
Regions and localities are truthful and responsive
Complex and physical-unit counts are correct
Mobile accessibility control is restrained and accessible
Gallery arrows are consistent and truthful
Mobile card navigation stays in tab and preserves return state
Holiday hero images hide only on mobile without gaps
Online booking uses one truthful mobile sticky action
Destination rails reach and return from both ends
Spa package sticky action hides at its target
Spa filters work with mobile keyboard
Popular-search visibility is consistent across worlds
Related searches use one mobile rail
Mobile footer has no dead gap
Accessibility information is not duplicated
Supplier video is durable and legacy-independent
Pets filter requires explicit acceptance
Availability and cache states are truthful
Templates have a measured spacing rhythm
Popular-search images are relevant and nonduplicated
Desktop date flow advances to rooms and party
Large parties receive truthful multi-unit combinations
Average per night appears only for multi-night stays
Slider image crops match approved cards
Guest reset clears state URL results and persistence
Event participant step and exact entry both work
Event inventory and ordering remain complete and truthful
Event dates arrows and galleries follow accepted contract
Event amenities reviews spacing and sticky contact work
Event share uses canonical place URL and copy
Event details remove redundant content and dead space
All affected families pass public release regression

risks.risk: UI facts disagree with supplier or canonical catalog truth
Touch, keyboard or low-height mobile state hides or overlaps controls
Cold media, cache or API failure creates blank or false state
A shared repair works in one world and regresses another
Published identity differs from tested candidate or retained tabs break
SEO or public content becomes duplicated, misleading or inaccessible

cases.preconditions: Golden supplier fixtures and exact dated queries exist
cases.action: Compare API/cache, full inventory, cards, detail and booking handoff including supplier failure
cases.oracle: Facts agree end to end; stale or unknown data never becomes false unavailable; booking revalidates

cases.preconditions: Cold cache and representative owner galleries across worlds
cases.action: Load, navigate, retry and resize cards, rails, recommendations and place galleries
cases.oracle: No settled blanks, cross-owner media, duplicate controls, wrong crop, direction or stuck arrow

cases.preconditions: Region-only and transactional search states on desktop and mobile
cases.action: Set, advance, clear, back, reload and repeat filters in every search world
cases.oracle: URL, chips, fields, counts, cards and navigation agree and cleared state does not return

cases.preconditions: 390px and 430px viewports plus low-height and keyboard-open states
cases.action: Open and interact with representative search and detail routes in each world
cases.oracle: No overlaps, white overlays, dead gaps, duplicated actions or unreachable controls

cases.preconditions: Rails contain more items than one viewport
cases.action: Use arrows and touch scroll to both true ends, then reverse direction
cases.oracle: Controls disable only at true ends and become active after reverse scroll

cases.preconditions: Known reviewed places and eligible/ineligible visit dates
cases.action: Compare summary/list, navigate past months, choose date and submit valid/invalid reviews
cases.oracle: Counts and score agree; RTL calendar and validation are correct; valid submission persists

cases.preconditions: Known event inventory with priced, unpriced, available, unknown and unavailable states
cases.action: Search exact participants/date, open place, gallery, reviews, contact and share
cases.oracle: Inventory is complete and truthfully ordered; date/gallery/review/share/contact behavior is place-specific

cases.preconditions: Mobile spa results and detail with packages
cases.action: Open filters with numeric keyboard, select values, close and scroll to package section
cases.oracle: Layout remains fitted and sticky CTA hides while its target is visible

cases.preconditions: Holiday and semantic landing routes on desktop and mobile
cases.action: Compare hero media, related rail, footer and representative tile media
cases.oracle: Desktop media remains; mobile hides it without gaps; links and alt/title stay meaningful

cases.preconditions: Loaded representative route with open interactive state
cases.action: Cross breakpoints, rotate, change height and reopen keyboard
cases.oracle: State remains usable; no stale measurements, hidden content, overlap or duplicated controls

cases.preconditions: Frozen cumulative candidate and full shared-component consumer inventory
cases.action: Run source, unit, build, visual and browser family suites before and after publication
cases.oracle: No P0/P1 regression and exact public identity matches the tested candidate

cases.preconditions: Release deployed with predecessor assets retained and rollback ready
cases.action: Open exact public routes in fresh and retained pre-release tabs, navigate and reload
cases.oracle: New and retained clients load correct assets, journeys pass, rollback trigger remains absent

out_of_scope: Inventing supplier facts absent from approved API or CMS
Changing unrelated accounts, billing, bindings or database ownership
